note: The depth lane's ways underground (26 Nov 2026): tunnels, cellars and a mine, each a placed thing of KIND tunnel (src/app/94-garden-zz-7act-0kinds.js), read by lib/garden-things.mjs like every vale-<x>.json. Not part of the saved-world identity: nothing here edits a region's cells. A row: id, kind 'tunnel', style (cellar | drift | adit | vault: GARDEN_TUNNEL_STYLES), name, on + at (against a fixed thing: it moves with it) or x, y (cells: the first mouth's threshold, on open ground), mouths [{ at (from the row's place), by (hatch | arch | adit | steps: how it is built), face (the way you walk in: n s e w) }], paths (lines from mouth to chamber, from the row's place; a point on a mouth's threshold means that mouth's stair foot), width (cells), chambers [{ at, r [rx, ry] (cells), what (GARDEN_CHAMBERS) }]. A mouth whose ground is not open yet is shut (a rockfall, a locked gate) until its land opens; the game checks every row (94-garden-zz-8depth-3tunnel.js) and leaves out what does not fit.

things.name: the deeds cellar
things.note: Cellar flaps in the paving against the Land Office's east wall, south of its lamp: a flagged cellar of shelves and an old plan chest under the office. One mouth: you come back up the way you went.

things.name: the drovers' way
things.note: A hatch in the yard on the empty old house's west side; under the house a store, and a long passage north under the fell scarp, up steps through the moor turf on the cliff top: the woodland's way on to the fells, eight cells for a walk round of forty-six.

things.name: the tower undercroft
things.note: A low half-sunk arch in the old tower's south face, east of its stair door, down to a vaulted room with a well shaft under the tower.

things.name: the cider run
things.note: Steps down on the river bank below the end of the terrace wall, a vault for the cider under the terraces, steps up on the orchard side by the river: the valley's way up to the High orchard without the long road round.

things.name: the lantern mine
things.note: An old timbered adit in the south-east foot of Cloudbreak's west peak, by the Cloudbreak Way: a gallery, a crystal chamber and a still pool in the rock.
